task.title: Choose how the app looks
task.shortdesc: Pick a colour theme, and a light or dark look, for this tablet.

context.p: These settings are for this tablet only. They do not change your family tree files.

step.cmd: Choose in the list on the left.

stepresult.p: The screen shows two groups of choices.

step.cmd: Under , choose a set of colours.

info.p: The first group has three themes, and a row of four colour squares shows each one. is the one in the pictures in this manual.
The first choice copies the setting you made on your tablet.

result.p: The change shows at once. The app keeps your choice the next time you open it.
